compiled_state.title: CLAUDE.md: reference .claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md -> path does not exist
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** HEAD

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

`.claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md` should exist at the path referenced in CLAUDE.md Architecture section ("follow .claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md for formatting") and in story ffab-402b acceptance criteria.

#### Actual Behavior

`find .claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md` returns empty. The `.claude/` directory has no `docs/` subdirectory. The completion-verifier for story ffab-402b noted: "DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md does not exist at the expected path (.claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md)".

The criterion in ffab-402b was vacuously satisfied because no documentation changes were made — but if future stories require conformance checking against this guide, they will silently skip it.
